rubric: A wrong expectation in the scenario.

criteria.cause: the scenario or the way it was driven is wrong; the app behaves as intended

reading.why: The page shows the correct 12.00; the scenario asserted 12.50 because of a fixture fee the page does not charge, so the scenario is wrong.

ruledOut.question: cause
ruledOut.label: product_bug
ruledOut.why: The scenario's expectation is wrong. It is not: the app does not do what the scenario asks.

ruledOut.question: cause
ruledOut.label: env_flake
ruledOut.why: The scenario's expectation is wrong. It is not: the target, the dev server, the browser or a tool failed; the scenario was never really tried.
